name: m_ex_combo_watermark
description: [mapgen-combo] Incremental load, watermark inside the BigQuery source query: in-out parameter p_last_ts (STRING, MAX) is substituted into WHERE updated_at > TIMESTAMP(...), so BigQuery filters; an Expression advances it with SETMAXVARIABLE on TO_CHAR(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US'); the target appends.

inOutParameters.name: p_last_ts
inOutParameters.description: high-water mark: max updated_at loaded so far, UTC text YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US (text order = time order; BigQuery TIMESTAMP() parses it back exactly)

nodes.name: SRC_WM_EVENTS
nodes.query: SELECT event_id, updated_at, amount, store_id, FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%E6S', updated_at, 'UTC') AS wm_txt_bq, '$$p_last_ts' AS wm_from FROM `${BQ_PROJECT}.${DATASET}.combo_wm_events` WHERE updated_at > TIMESTAMP('$$p_last_ts')
